summary: The current VEC stores approved fact IDs and handles as unrelated sets. A reference or audio binding can therefore combine the fact_id of one approved fact with the fact_handle of another approved fact. Both VisualExecutionContract validation and the current Gate 0 binding check accept this counterfeit pair.

reproducible_observations.name: reference_fact_id_handle_pair_mismatch
reproducible_observations.method: Construct a valid VEC, replace one ReferenceRequirement.source_fact_id with another approved fact ID while retaining the original approved handle, and reconstruct the frozen VEC type.

reproducible_observations.name: audio_fact_id_handle_pair_mismatch
reproducible_observations.method: Construct a valid VEC, replace one AudioEvent.source_fact_id with another approved fact ID while retaining the original approved handle, and reconstruct the frozen VEC type.

code_evidence.finding: It tests fact_id membership and fact_handle membership independently, so it cannot prove that both values resolve to the same FactRegistry member.
Gate 0 repeats the independent-set check and therefore cannot close the malformed-pair path.
The assembler emits correct pairs for its happy path, but its output type and Gate 0 do not make the pair relationship an independently verifiable invariant.

root_cause: A1 froze a VEC representation that retained parallel ID and handle collections but did not encode or validate their exact pairing. A7 later consumed the same weakened representation and duplicated its independent-membership check. A5 cannot repair this without modifying the already frozen A1 domain contract and the downstream A7 gate.
required_repair_order: Invalidate the completed A1-to-A4 dependency chain because its evidence cannot prove the exact typed-binding invariant.
At A1, make the approved fact ID-to-handle relationship canonical and reject any ReferenceRequirement or AudioEvent whose pair is not an exact approved pair.
At A5, revalidate deterministic assembly against the strengthened frozen A1 contract without adding compatibility fields or free-text inference.
At A7, make Gate 0 fail the same pair-mismatch mutations and ensure downstream review inputs preserve the exact mapping.
Revalidate every downstream package only after its registered work package is selected by ReleaseLedger.
rejected_repairs: Do not patch only A5: its assembler already emits correct pairs, and a local assertion would not protect independently deserialized or tampered VEC artifacts.
Do not retain the independent-set check as a compatibility mode: it leaves a counterfeit binding accepted.
Do not infer a pairing from fact text, ID prefixes, natural-language labels, or source spans.
